metadata.question: Did the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels over Taiwan increase between February 10-25, 2020 and April 20-May 12, 2020?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-5P NO2 Level-3 collections over Taiwan. Try OFFL first (COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2), fall back to NRTI (COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3_NO2) if empty. Date windows: 2020-02-10..2020-02-25 and 2020-04-20..2020-05-12. ROI: Try LSIB Taiwan; fallback to a Taiwan bounding polygon if not found.
2. Masking strategy: Mask pixels with qa_value < 0.75 (standard quality filter). No additional cloud mask beyond QA.
3. Validity: Check collection sizes; if zero after fallback => C1. After masking and compositing, if valid pixel count == 0 => C2. If mean is null or non-finite or absurd (>0.01 mol/m^2) => C3. Otherwise compare means; if period 2 > period 1 => A, else B.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const start1 = '2020-02-10';
    const end1 = '2020-02-25';
    const start2 = '2020-04-20';
    const end2 = '2020-05-12';

    // ROI: Try LSIB 'Taiwan', else fallback to bounding polygon.
    const lsib = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017').filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Taiwan'));
    const lsibSize = await lsib.size().getInfo();
    let roi, roiSource;
    if (lsibSize && lsibSize > 0) {
      roi = lsib.geometry();
      roiSource = 'LSIB Taiwan';
    } else {
      // Bounding polygon around Taiwan main island
      roi = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
        [119.0, 25.8], [122.5, 25.8], [122.5, 21.5], [119.0, 21.5], [119.0, 25.8]
      ]);
      roiSource = 'Bounding Box';
    }

    // Helper to load and compute stats
    async function periodStats(start, end, roi) {
      const colIds = ['COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2', 'COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3_NO2'];
      let colUsed = null;
      let rawCol = null;
      let rawSize = 0;
      for (const id of colIds) {
        const c = ee.ImageCollection(id).filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(roi);
        const s = await c.size().getInfo();
        if (s > 0) {
          colUsed = id;
          rawCol = c;
          rawSize = s;
          break;
        }
      }
      if (!colUsed) {
        return { empty: true, images: 0 };
      }
      // Mask with qa_value >= 0.75 and select tropospheric band
      const masked = rawCol.map(function(img) {
        const qaMask = img.select('qa_value').gte(0.75);
        return img.updateMask(qaMask);
      }).select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density');

      const composite = masked.mean().clip(roi);

      // Count valid pixels after masking
      const countDict = await composite.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: 5000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).getInfo();
      const validPx = countDict ? countDict['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'] : 0;
      if (!validPx || validPx === 0) {
        return { empty: false, images: rawSize, colId: colUsed, noValid: true };
      }

      // Spatial mean of the composite
      const meanDict = await composite.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: 5000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).getInfo();
      const meanVal = meanDict ? meanDict['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'] : null;

      // Validation for calculation failure
      if (meanVal === null || meanVal === undefined || !isFinite(meanVal) || Math.abs(meanVal) > 0.01) {
        return { empty: false, images: rawSize, colId: colUsed, fail: true };
      }

      return { empty: false, images: rawSize, colId: colUsed, validPx: validPx, mean: meanVal };
    }

    console.log(`ROI: ${roiSource}`);
    console.log(`QA filter: qa_value >= 0.75`);
    const p1 = await periodStats(start1, end1, roi);
    const p2 = await periodStats(start2, end2, roi);

    // Handle empty collections
    if (p1.empty || p2.empty) {
      console.log(`P1 ${start1}..${end1} Images: ${p1.images || 0}`);
      console.log(`P2 ${start2}..${end2} Images: ${p2.images || 0}`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    // Handle no valid pixels
    if (p1.noValid || p2.noValid) {
      console.log(`P1 ${start1}..${end1} Images: ${p1.images}, Valid px: ${p1.validPx || 0}`);
      console.log(`P2 ${start2}..${end2} Images: ${p2.images}, Valid px: ${p2.validPx || 0}`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    // Handle calculation failure
    if (p1.fail || p2.fail || p1.mean === null || p2.mean === null || !isFinite(p1.mean) || !isFinite(p2.mean)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    console.log(`Dataset P1: ${p1.colId}`);
    console.log(`Dataset P2: ${p2.colId}`);
    console.log(`P1 ${start1}..${end1} | Images: ${p1.images} | Valid px: ${p1.validPx} | Mean NO2: ${p1.mean.toExponential(3)} mol/m^2`);
    console.log(`P2 ${start2}..${end2} | Images: ${p2.images} | Valid px: ${p2.validPx} | Mean NO2: ${p2.mean.toExponential(3)} mol/m^2`);
    const diff = p2.mean - p1.mean;
    console.log(`Diff (P2 - P1): ${diff.toExponential(3)} mol/m^2`);

    // Final Answer
    if (diff > 0) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
